name: Jeremy Severinsen
story: LINZ’s 2014 geospatial virtual field trip named Jeremy Severinsen as a Portfolio Manager and subject-matter expert explaining geospatial work to schools. The record provides a named example of the programme and management roles that sat alongside technical specialists in the national location-information system.
LINZ names Jeremy Severinsen in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Portfolio Manager, LINZ, 2014 VFT.
